chapter.verse: Abram kum sawmkua-le-kua a phak ciangin ama’ tungah Topa kilang a, “Keimah in Vanglian Pasian ka hi hi; hoih takin gamta in la, paubaang kei in.
Kei leh nang' kikal-ah ka thuciamna ka bawl ding a, nang tampi tak kong phasak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abram mai kun suk hi; Pasian in ama' kiangah,
“En in, nang' tungah hih thuciamna kong bawl hi: Nang in minam honpite’ pa na hi ding hi.
Na min in Abram hi nawn lo ding a, Abraham hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh minam honpite’ pa-in nang kong bawl khin hi.
Keimah in suan-le-khak tampi kong neisak ding hi; nang' sung panin minamte ka piangsak ding a, nang' sung panin kumpite hong piangkhia ding hi.

Nang leh nang’ khit cianga na suan-le-khakte' tungah Pasian ka hihna ding tawntung thuciam nadingin kei leh nang leh nang’ khit cianga na suan-le-khakte’ kikal-ah amau' khang tawntungin ka thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi.
Nangma' tung leh nang’ khit cianga na suan-le-khakte’ tungah tawlkhat na omna Kanaan leitang khempeuh na neih tawntung dingun kong pia ding hi; keimah in amaute’ Pasian ka hi ding hi,” ci hi.
Pasian in Abraham’ kiangah, “Nang leh nang’ khit cianga na suan-le-khakte in zong ka thuciamna na zuih ding uh nong thukim ding uh ahi hi.
Hih in kei leh nang leh nang’ khit cianga na suan-le-khakte’ kikalah note’ zuih ding keima thuciamna ahi hi: Note’ lak panin pasal peuhmah vun ki-at ding hi.
Note’ vun dawn ki-at ding a, tua in kei leh note’ kikalah thuciamna lim khat hi ding hi.

Note' lak panin ni giat a pha peuhmahpa’ vun ki-at ding hi; note’ khang tawntungin pasal peuhmah, note’ inn sunga suak hita leh, note’ ta ahi lo, gamdang mi khatpeuh kiang panin na sum uh tawh na lei uh hita leh,
na inn sunga suak hita leh, na sum tawh a kileipa hita leh vun ki-at tuak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tawntung thuciamna ahi keima thuciamna in nomau’ satak sungah om ding hi.
Ama vun dawn a ki-at lo, vun a ki-at lo pasal peuhmah ama mite kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi; amah in keima thuciamna palsat hi,” ci hi.
Pasian in Abraham’ kiangah, “Na zi Sarai ahih leh, ama' min Sarai na ci nawn kei ding a, ama' min Sarah hi ding hi.
Amah thupha ka pia ding a, amah tawh tapa khat kong pia ding hi; amah thupha ka pia ding a, amah in minamte’ nu hi ding hi; mihingte’ kumpite ama' sung pan hong piangkhia ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham mai kun sukin nui a, amahmah' tungah, “Kum za a pha pasal khat in ta nei ding ahi hiam? Kum sawmkua a pha Sarah in ta nei ding ahi hiam?” kici hi.
Abraham in Pasian’ kiangah, “Ishmael hong nungtasak peuh lecin,” ci hi.

Pasian in, “Hi lo hi, na zi Sarah in nang’ adingin tapa khat nei ding a, ama' min Isaak na ci ding hi. Ama' khit cianga a suan-le-khakte adingin tawntung thuciamna dingin ka thuciamna amah tawh ka kipsak ding hi.

Ishmael’ ading na ngetna ahih leh ka za khin hi; en in, amah thupha pia-in ka pungsak ding a, tampi tak ka phasak ding hi; amah in ulian sawm-le-nihte’ pa hi ding a, minam lian khatin amah ka bawl ding hi.
Ahih hangin, kum kik tu hun ciangin Sarah sung panin nang adinga hong suak ding Isaak tawh ka thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah tawh a kiho a man khit ciangin Abraham' kiang panin Pasian paikhia to hi.

Tua ciangin Abraham in a tapa Ishmael leh ama' sum tawh a lei hita leh ama' inn sunga suak hita leh a sila khempeuh, ama' inn sunga om mite' lak panin pasal khempeuh samin, Pasian in ama' tunga a gensa bangin tua ni mahmahin amaute’ vun dawn atsak hi.
Ama' vun dawn a ki-atin Abraham kum sawmkua-le-kua pha hi;
ama' vun dawn a ki-at hunin a tapa Ishmael kum sawm-le-thum pha hi.
Tua ni mahmahin Abraham leh a tapa Ishmaelte a vun uh ki-at hi;
ama' inn sunga pasal khempeuh, inn sunga suak hita leh gamdang mite’ tung pan-a sum tawh a kilei mite hita leh, amah tawh a vun uh ki-at khawm hi.
